raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner inverted the comparison logic by stating to use “the maximum/largest birth year” to identify the “oldest” director. Older corresponds to the earliest (smallest) birth year, not the largest. This mis-specified criterion would directly lead to selecting the wrong film as having the older director, even if the data were correctly gathered.
